prompt: Which U.S. National Park was the first to be established after the Portland Trail Blazers won their only playoff series with LaMarcus Aldridge on the team?
answer:
The **Gateway Arch National Park** was the first U.S. national park established after the Trail Blazers won a playoff series with LaMarcus Aldridge on the roster.

Portland’s 2014 first-round victory over the Houston Rockets—completed on **May 2, 2014**—was Aldridge’s first playoff-series win with the team. Gateway Arch National Park was designated on **February 22, 2018**.
